metadata.description: Partial audit checklist for remaining properties in zERC20 Privacy Token Protocol (batch 8)

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-NOVA-FOLD-STEP executes correct Nova folding computation
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate Nova folding step implementation in prover code
2. Verify folding uses correct R1CS relaxation formula
3. Check accumulator update follows Nova spec: (W', x', u', E') = fold(W, x, u, E, w, x_new)
4. Verify random challenge r is derived correctly (Fiat-Shamir)
5. Confirm cross-term T computation is correct
6. Ensure folding preserves satisfied constraint relationship

executable_checks.command: Review Nova folding computation against specification
executable_checks.assertion: Folding follows Nova IVC protocol correctly

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-NOVA-FOLD-STEP -> Action ACTION-NOVA-FOLD-STEP. Nova IVC soundness depends on correct folding. Invalid folding would produce proofs that fail on-chain verification.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-NOVA-FOLDING-LOOP accumulates all transfers without skipping or double-counting
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate folding loop state management in prover
2. Verify loop iterator processes each transfer exactly once
3. Check transfer index tracking matches on-chain state
4. Confirm no off-by-one errors in loop bounds
5. Verify early termination conditions are correct
6. Ensure state vector tracks progress accurately
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-NOVA-FOLDING-LOOP -> Node STATE-NOVA-FOLDING-LOOP. Accumulation correctness ensures proof covers exactly the claimed transfers.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-NOVA-FINALIZE-IVC produces valid finalized IVC proof
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate IVC finalization logic in prover
2. Verify final accumulator is correctly committed
3. Check public inputs are properly extracted
4. Confirm finalization includes all required proof components
5. Verify local verification passes before output
6. Ensure serialization format is correct for Groth16 conversion

executable_checks.command: Review finalization produces complete proof structure

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-NOVA-FINALIZE -> Action ACTION-NOVA-FINALIZE-IVC. Finalization must produce a proof that can be successfully converted to Groth16 and verified on-chain.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-NOVA-IVC-COMPLETE only reached after successful finalization and local verification
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Trace all code paths leading to IVC complete state
2. Verify local verification is mandatory before completion
3. Check no early returns bypass verification
4. Confirm error handling doesn't mark incomplete as complete
5. Verify state flag is set atomically with verification success

executable_checks.command: Trace code paths to completion state
executable_checks.assertion: All paths require successful local verification

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-NOVA-IVC-COMPLETE -> Node STATE-NOVA-IVC-COMPLETE. Ensures incomplete proofs are never marked as ready.

checklist.title: Verify all edges in GRAPH-NOVA-PROOF-GENERATION maintain proof generation integrity
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Map all state transitions in Nova proof generation pipeline
2. Verify EDGE-NOVA-GEN-START properly initializes state
3. Check EDGE-NOVA-PROOFS-FETCHED validates fetched proof data
4. Confirm EDGE-NOVA-PARAMS-LOADED verifies parameter integrity
5. Verify EDGE-NOVA-WITNESS-READY ensures witness completeness
6. Check EDGE-NOVA-FOLD-* transitions maintain accumulator state
7. Verify EDGE-NOVA-IVC-FINALIZED correctly terminates

executable_checks.command: Review all edge transitions in proof generation flow

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-NOVA-GEN-EDGES -> Sub-graph edges. All transitions are deterministic computations that should not corrupt state.

checklist.title: Verify all nodes in GRAPH-NOVA-TO-GROTH16 maintain proof conversion integrity
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate Nova-to-Groth16 conversion (decider) implementation
2. Verify STATE-DECIDER-INIT properly initializes conversion
3. Check ACTION-DECIDER-DESERIALIZE-IVC handles malformed input
4. Verify ACTION-DECIDER-LOAD-GROTH16-PK uses correct proving key
5. Confirm ACTION-DECIDER-VERIFY-IVC-LOCALLY runs before conversion
6. Verify ACTION-DECIDER-GENERATE-GROTH16 uses correct circuit
7. Check ACTION-DECIDER-SERIALIZE-PROOF produces on-chain-compatible format

executable_checks.command: Verify conversion produces valid Groth16 proof

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-DECIDER-STATES -> Sub-graph nodes. Groth16 soundness guarantee. Invalid conversion fails on-chain verification.

executable_checks.assertion: Deterministic conversion steps preserve proof validity

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-DECIDER-EDGES -> Sub-graph edges. All transitions are deterministic and should not corrupt conversion.

checklist.title: Verify all nodes in GRAPH-NOVA-PROOF-VERIFICATION enforce proof validation

5. Verify ACTION-VERIFY-CALL-ROOT-DECIDER invokes Groth16 verifier
6. Check ACTION-VERIFY-CHECK-PROOF-CONSISTENCY detects divergent proofs
7. Verify ACTION-VERIFY-STORE-ROOT only stores after verification
8. Confirm STATE-VERIFY-EMERGENCY triggers on divergence
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-VERIFY-ROOT-STATES -> Sub-graph nodes. Groth16 cryptographic guarantee. All nodes must enforce their validation logic.

executable_checks.assertion: All transitions require prior validation success

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-SUBGRAPH-VERIFY-ROOT-EDGES -> Sub-graph edges. No edge should allow skipping validation steps.
